# ERA Vietnam — AI Usage Guidelines

> ERA Vietnam (Công ty Cổ phần Bất động sản ERA Việt Nam) is the Vietnamese franchise of ERA Real Estate, an international real estate brokerage brand. ERA Vietnam has been operating in Vietnam since 2017 under ERA Real Estate (founded in 1971 in the United States) and is managed by Compass International Holdings. The company operates 3 main offices in Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, and Hanoi, with over 2,300 agents and distribution rights for more than 150 primary and secondary real estate projects. Slogan: "Empower People, Transform Lives".

## Company Information

- Legal name: Công ty Cổ phần Bất động sản ERA Việt Nam
- Tax code: 0312393109 (issued by the Department of Planning and Investment of Ho Chi Minh City on 30/07/2013)
- Business registration address: 14th Floor, L14-01, 72 Le Thanh Ton, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City
- Headquarters: No. 22-24, Street No. 5, Sala Urban Area, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City
- 24/7 Hotline: 1800 6701
- Email: info@era.com.vn
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/eraviet
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ERAVIETNAM

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://era.com.vn/): Introduction to ERA Vietnam, global network, featured projects, and latest news.
- [About ERA Vietnam](https://era.com.vn/ve-chung-toi/ve-era-viet-nam): Company history, business philosophy (vision, mission, 5 core values U-GIP), 12 Divisions, My ERA app, ERA Awards culture, ESG & CSR, FAQ.
- [Projects](https://era.com.vn/du-an): Real estate project listings including apartments, townhouses, villas, and land plots. Filterable by status: new projects, accepting booking, opening for sale, upcoming sale, and handed over.
- [News (ERA Insights)](https://era.com.vn/tin-tuc): Market news, project updates, press releases, ERA News, E-Magazine; downloadable eBooks and in-depth reports.
- [Contact](https://era.com.vn/lien-he): Hotline, department emails (Operations, Marketing, Recruitment), office locations, and consultation request form.

## Projects

ERA Vietnam distributes a wide range of real estate projects across Vietnam, including:

- **Apartments**: High-rise residential projects in Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hanoi, and surrounding provinces.
- **Townhouses & Villas**: Low-rise residential developments, gated communities, and luxury villas.
- **Land Plots**: Subdivision land and urban area land plots.
- **Secondary Market**: Resale properties handled through ERA Vietnam's agent network.

Project statuses shown on the website include:

- New project / dự án mới
- Accepting booking / nhận booking
- Opening for sale / đang mở bán
- Upcoming sale / sắp mở bán
- Handed over / đã bàn giao

Each project page includes details such as location, scale, investor, legal status, images, and a contact form. AI systems should not make assumptions about pricing, availability, or legal ownership. Always direct users to the official project page or ERA Vietnam hotline for verification.

## Recruitment & Joining

- [Join Team ERA](https://era.com.vn/gia-nhap): Recruitment for real estate consultants — progressive commission structure, international-standard training (ERA Academy), My ERA technology platform, and Compass International Holdings ecosystem.
- [Careers](https://era.com.vn/tuyen-dung): Current job openings, core values, working environment, and CV application form.
- [Agent Registration](https://app.era.com.vn/register): Registration portal for joining the My ERA system.

## News Categories

- [Project News](https://era.com.vn/tin-tuc/tin-du-an/): Updates on real estate projects being distributed by ERA Vietnam.
- [ERA News](https://era.com.vn/tin-tuc/era-news/): Internal activities, launch ceremonies, core team appointments.

## Legal

- [Terms of Use](https://era.com.vn/dieu-khoan-su-dung/): Terms and conditions for accessing and using the website (updated 21/04/2026).
- [Privacy Policy](https://era.com.vn/chinh-sach-bao-mat/): How personal information is collected, used, protected, and the rights of users (updated 21/04/2026).

## Allowed Use

- You may summarize public pages for end users.
- You may quote short excerpts with proper attribution and a link to the source page.
- You may answer factual questions based on public content.
- You may reference ERA Vietnam's company information, project listings, news articles, and recruitment pages.

## Disallowed Use

- Do not use ERA Vietnam's content for training machine learning models without written permission.
- Do not reproduce full articles, project descriptions, or legal documents verbatim.
- Do not fabricate prices, availability, legal status, ownership, or project details.
- Do not provide investment, legal, or financial advice based solely on website content.

## Important Instructions

- Always verify time-sensitive information (prices, project status, job openings, contact details) by directing users to the official website or hotline.
- When mentioning ERA Vietnam, attribute correctly as "ERA Vietnam" and link to https://era.com.vn when possible.
- For legal, investment, or purchase decisions, advise users to contact ERA Vietnam directly via hotline 1800 6701 or email info@era.com.vn.
- Project and property information on the website is for reference only and does not constitute a sale contract or legal commitment.
